text: - By invocation: a build that resolves the whole workspace (`cargo test --workspace`, `ci-leg.sh fast`, CI's test leg) turns `blitz-dom/tracing` on — blitz's default `tracing` reaches blitz-shell and blitz-html, and each of those forwards to blitz-dom — while `cargo test -p blitz-tests` and a `-p seven_guis` build leave it off; so under the workspace build a test child that installs escher's sink at `info` also receives engine events: one `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]` beside a driver `type` (packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1872; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/evidence/feature-unification.md, from cargo's resolved feature graph, the event at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md; test-plan §9 → Engine features by runner). Measured at 2026-10-10-driver-cli for the session host: on a snapshot · click · type flow the workspace-built `escher-session` host prints that one engine line, `blitz_dom::document` at INFO, from `info` up and no further line at `debug` or `trace`, and the host built alone (`-p seven_guis`) prints none (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep on the same flow, the workspace-built host prints that engine line twice from `info` up — `trace` adding no line — and the host built alone still none (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md). Measured since 2026-10-14-quality-gates: the windowed `seven_guis_native`'s stderr by level as a workspace build makes it, on the host's display, with 0 needles (§8; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/stderr-by-level.md)

text:
- Past escher's scrub: the chained std panic hook prints the raw panic message to stderr, and the allowlisted `log.file` can still carry a host path, now only for a bridged `log` record under an engine target (`js_console`) — the bridged third-party records that carried one at `RUST_LOG=info` (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-telemetry-bootstrap/report.md) are dropped whole since 2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist (recorded by construction, not measured: a dropped record writes zero bytes, and `log.file` occurrences were not counted in that chunk's readings). A record from a target outside the sink's allowlist no longer reaches stderr at all (Scrubbing, below) — measured before → after the drop on both sink-installing binaries at four `RUST_LOG` settings, as stderr lines and as the instrument's fixed id and name needles found: the `escher-session` binary (the CRUD task, one `hello`, then `stop`) 0 → 0 lines unset (the default `warn`), 1 → 1 at `info`, 1165 → 1 at `debug` with ids 15 of 15 → 0, 1501 → 1 at `trace` with ids 15 of 15 → 0 and names 6 of 6 → 0; the windowed `seven_guis_native` (left on Home for 10 s, nobody clicks — its first reading by level) 1 → 0 lines unset, 3 → 1 at `info`, 12,413 → 1 at `debug` with ids 11 of 11 → 0, 47,482 → 1 at `trace` with ids 11 of 11 → 0 and names 5 of 5 → 0; the one line left at `info`, `debug` and `trace` is the install line `INFO escher_telemetry`, and stdout is 0 bytes in all 16 readings.
 Typed text was first measured in process: since 2026-10-07-act-by-id a typing command exists — the driver's `type`, through `Session::run` — and types into an instance held in process; `stand_act_spans`'s re-run child drove the six instance-level verbs of that day, `type` included, with the sink installed over a capture at `RUST_LOG=info`, in both layout modes, and the capture holds 0 of 36 id needles, 0 of 8 name needles and 0 occurrences of the three supplied texts (the typed text, the id naming no element, the unknown verb's text), with no value reading redacted on a driver line; the verb table held seven since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, when `stand_act_spans` also began checking a refused shot's `fonts-unavailable` cause on the span, and holds eight with the `lint` verb, whose accepted line and refused no-font line `stand_act_spans` also reads (36 calls per mode, eight verbs read back, two part reads among them — part 1, and part 2 of the shared `many_items` page held as `paged`, read as `Outcome::Part` with at least 2 parts, its 400 `item-NNN` ids and its buttons' text joining the id and name needles (`Needles::read`), none on a captured line — each line `verb` alone). A shot's image is screen content that leaves only in its answer: 0 occurrences of the first 64 base64 characters of a shot in the `escher-session` host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, under both builds (`host_log`, `mcp_log`; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md).
 Typed text in a HOST's log is measured since 2026-10-10-driver-cli: a hosted `type` reaches the `escher-session` host's instance, and that host's stderr at `RUST_LOG=trace` holds 0 occurrences of the typed sentinel, 0 id needles and 0 name needles under both builds (`host_log` green as `-p seven_guis` and as `--workspace`); by level, on a snapshot · click · type flow with three commands, the host built alone writes 0 lines unset and 4 at `info`, `debug` and `trace` — three command-span lines and the install line, 742 B — and the workspace-built host 5, one `blitz_dom::document` INFO line more, 860 B, with 0 of 15 id needles, 0 of 6 name needles and 0 sentinel occurrences at every level and stdout 0 B in all eight runs (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the three readings that left out are taken too — a client's own stderr (a one-off reading; a standing check below), the host on flows beyond those three commands, and the windowed `seven_guis_native` built with the workspace, on the host's display (`wayland-1`) — 28 runs by build and level, 0 needles in every run (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/stderr-by-level.md); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep on the same flow, the host built alone is unchanged (4 lines, 742 B) and the workspace-built host writes 6 lines, 978 B — the `blitz_dom::document` `focussed node` INFO line now printing twice where it printed once, its message `[redacted]` — with the id, name and typed-sentinel needles still 0 at `info` and `trace` under both builds (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md).
 A recording session's clients are read by a standing check: `host_log`'s third test (unix only) runs each client command through `common::run` at `RUST_LOG=trace` — `start crud --record`, `type` with a sentinel, `snapshot`, `snapshot --part 1`, `lint`, `stop` — in the state directories `hl-client` and `hl-client-rec`, guarded by `common::Started`, and over all the clients' own stderr reads 0 id, 0 name, 0 sentinel, 0 recording-path and 0 `recorded_needles` occurrences under both builds (`host_log` 3, green as `-p seven_guis` and as `--workspace`); a paged `part` read through the `escher-session` host's own sink stays unmeasured — the host boots only the four lean tasks and none pages — its measurement owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next) (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md).
 The session host's reading above, of a host that runs no call, was re-measured unchanged at 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans — 0 · 1 · 1 · 1 stderr lines, ids 0 of 15, names 0 of 6, stdout 0 B (the readings above as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/evidence/by-level.md; the typing command at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/report.md; the in-process capture and the re-measurement at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md).
 The sink allowlist re-checked after the upstream take read at `f9cbb2756` holds: no scrub set, redaction shape or violation schema moves, `packages/escher-telemetry/`, `packages/escher-driver/` and `packages/dioxus-native-dom/` unchanged; `host_log` and `mcp_log` (the host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, read for id, name and typed-sentinel needles) pass in the per-package and the workspace build; the taken commits' added engine lines hold one commented `dbg!` and no log site, `hit_test_dropped_nodes` reads 0 env · 0 print · 0 subscriber, and the root example `multi_doc` writes its timings with one `println!` to stdout, outside escher's sink, holding no page or user content (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md)
